scripts.resume:pdf: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct 2>/dev/null || echo 0) typst compile --root . --ignore-system-fonts resume/resume.typ dist/emre-varol-resume.pdf
scripts.resume:verify: npm run resume:pdf && node scripts/verify-pdf.mjs dist/emre-varol-resume.pdf
scripts.og:png: mkdir -p dist/og && SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct 2>/dev/null || echo 0) typst compile --root . --ignore-system-fonts --format png --ppi 72 og/card.typ dist/og/default.png
scripts.assets: npm run resume:pdf && npm run og:png
